data.name: Workflow.Path.Help
data.value: Choose the path that matches your actual access. Authenticated change, password reset, and manual recovery have different requirements.

data.name: Workflow.Path.AuthenticatedChange
data.value: Change the password in an authenticated account session

data.name: Workflow.Path.PasswordReset
data.value: Reset the password through a secured recovery channel

data.name: Workflow.Path.ManualRecovery
data.value: Use the provider's manual account-recovery process

data.name: Workflow.Path.ChangeHelp
data.value: The path can change only before action progress, notes, or a generated-credential reference have been recorded. This prevents required work from being silently discarded.

data.name: Workflow.Access.Help
data.value: Record the real access state. Lost access and provider review require a non-secret reason and return you to the recalculated plan.

data.name: Workflow.Automation.Automated
data.value: Support: bounded automation with explicit authorization

data.name: Workflow.Navigation.Disclaimer
data.value: Check the destination and origin before opening it. Opening the page, returning to unpwn, or waiting does not complete this action.

data.name: Workflow.Navigation.Opened
data.value: The official page was opened. The action remains unchanged until you explicitly confirm its completion criteria.

data.name: Workflow.Navigation.Unavailable
data.value: The official page could not be opened safely. Continue with the displayed manual guidance.

data.name: Workflow.Navigation.Rejected
data.value: The operating system did not open the page. No recovery action was marked complete.

data.name: Workflow.Completion.Help
data.value: Confirm only after every listed criterion is actually true. Navigation alone is never sufficient.

data.name: Workflow.Completion.Acknowledge
data.value: I verified that the listed completion criteria are met.

data.name: Workflow.Complete.Confirmation.Consequence
data.value: This records only your explicit confirmation that the repository-defined criteria are met. unpwn did not verify the provider account.

data.name: Workflow.Notes.Warning
data.value: Do not enter passwords, reset links, tokens, MFA secrets, recovery codes, cookies, browser state, or identity documents. Generated credentials are linked through an opaque vault reference.

data.name: Workflow.Credential.None
data.value: No generated credential is linked to this action.

data.name: Workflow.Reason.Placeholder
data.value: Non-secret reason required for blocked, failed, waiting, lost-access, not-applicable, and risk decisions

data.name: Workflow.Reason.TrulyNotApplicable
data.value: The capability is not available for this account.

data.name: Workflow.NotApplicable.Confirmation.Consequence
data.value: Use this only when the capability genuinely does not exist for this account. An unavailable or declined control must remain an unresolved risk.

data.name: Workflow.Risk.Confirmation.Consequence
data.value: The required action remains unresolved and the account will not be represented as fully secured.

data.name: Workflow.Status.Ready.Message
data.value: Review the account context and select the path that matches your real access.

data.name: Workflow.Status.Started.Message
data.value: Work through each required action separately and record the actual outcome.

data.name: Workflow.Status.Active.Message
data.value: Blocked work, failures, lost access, and unresolved risks remain visible in the recovery plan.

data.name: Workflow.Plan.Changed
data.value: The recommended account or action changed after the recorded outcome. Review the current recommendation before continuing.

data.name: Workflow.Plan.Unchanged
data.value: The plan was recalculated. The current recommendation remains the same and unresolved work is still visible.

data.value: Unlock a vault and load an account inventory before starting account recovery.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.AccountUnavailable
data.value: The selected account is no longer available in the encrypted inventory.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.ProviderUnsupported
data.value: No reviewed repository workflow is available for this provider. Use the account inventory and manual guidance; unpwn will not guess provider instructions.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.PathRequired
data.value: Select a recovery path before starting.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.CriteriaRequired
data.value: Explicitly acknowledge the completion criteria before recording completion.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.ReasonRequired
data.value: Enter a non-secret reason for this outcome.

data.name: Workflow.Validation.NotFound
data.value: No persisted execution was found for this account.

data.value: The recovery state changed elsewhere or the requested transition is not allowed. Refresh before continuing.

data.value: The requested recovery transition is invalid.
